# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated alongside the core assessment report. Use the links below to navigate directly to the available fact documents.

- [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) - High-level system layers and detailed component relationships.
- [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) - External packages grouped by functional category and testing stack.

- [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, repository patterns, and entity relationships.
- [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, secrets, and runtime settings.
- [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) - Core commerce workflows, rules, and cross-service business flows.
